Read the paper ↗
REINFORCEMENT LEARNING
SIM-TO-REAL
Figure: Ghignone et al. (mono eyebrow, under the figure pane, as PublicationCard does now)
8 segments, 2 px, gap 8, width 128; done = ink 0.9, current fills left to right over 8 s (linear), rest = track ink 0.10; two 32 px hairline arrows at the right
RESEARCH CAROUSEL SPEC (landing v5 section 5). Copy the values literally. Frame = 1440 wide, content 1152 (max-w-content), section 07 on paper. New
component ui/ResearchCarousel.tsx; PublicationCard stays for /research.
STAGE (md and up): [prev thumb 120] 24 [current card 864 x 440] 24 [next thumb 120]. Card: hairline rgb(11 12 20 / 0.10), radius-card 4 px, paper-50.
Figure pane 480 wide, paper-100, the figure object-contain with a 24 px inset, credit line 'Figure: <surname> et al.' under the pane (mono eyebrow,
text-muted, via figureCredit). Text pane: padding 32, width 320 inside: mono 12 px text-muted '<i> / 8 · <venue_short> <year> · <tags>'; title
display 600 22 px text-strong, at most 3 lines; authors 14 px text-body (authorLine); abstract 15 px / 23 px text-body, line-clamp 6 (the
`abstract` field, verbatim, no rewriting; ellipsis at the clamp); 'Read the paper ↗' 14 px 600 ink underline (hover violet underline, the site link
rule); tag chips as PublicationCard.
THUMBS: the previous and next papers' figures, object-cover, opacity 0.45 (0.8 on hover and focus-visible), each a button 'Previous: <title>' / 'Next:
<title>'. No text in the thumbs.
TIMER: 8 s per paper, all 8 in order, loops. Pauses while the pointer is over the stage, while focus is inside the section, while the section is less
than 50 percent in view, and when document.hidden; resumes where it left off. Any manual move (arrow, thumb, segment) restarts the 8 s for the new
paper.
STRIP: 8 segments 2 px tall, gap 8, between the arrows; segments are buttons 'Go to paper <i>: <title>'. Done segments ink 0.9, the current one fills
left to right over the 8 s (transform scaleX from the left, linear, driven by requestAnimationFrame, not a CSS animation that can drift from the
timer), upcoming ones track only. On wrap, all segments reset.
SWAP: the card content crossfades in place, no physical slide: outgoing text pane and figure opacity 1 -> 0 in 140 ms; incoming opacity 0 -> 1 and
translateX 16 px -> 0 (from the travel direction) in 260 ms ease-out-expo; thumbs crossfade in the same 260 ms. Height never changes (card is 440
fixed from md). Reduced motion: no timer, no transforms, 180 ms opacity only, arrows and strip work.
A11Y: section role region, aria-roledescription 'carousel', aria-label 'Featured publications'; the current card role group aria-roledescription
'slide' aria-label '<i> of 8'; an sr-only aria-live polite line announces the current title on change; arrow keys on the strip move; the strip is a
tablist-free row of buttons (no roving focus needed).
UNDER MD: the card stacks (figure 16/10 on top, text below, abstract clamp 5), no thumbs, no timer; horizontal scroll-snap between the eight cards
with the strip as static position indicators; arrows hidden.
DATA (stream C): featured_order 1..8 on eight papers in publications.json; the figure file per paper is `figure` (1600 px wide WebP under 200 KB,
public/media/research/) made with scripts/paper_thumbs.py extended with --figure <n> (nth arXiv HTML figure) and --size 1600; the `abstract` field
filled from arXiv or OpenAlex where missing (verbatim, source in `source`); THUMBS.md rows per file. Page-1 crops are not figures: a paper without
a real figure does not go in the eight.
